mission: Mission 10 — CBraMod Product-Role Decision & Gate Re-evaluation
decision_rationale: Mission 9 proved a strong within-session subject-identity / geometry advantage but failed the MI-accuracy guardrail. The MI gate was role-mismatched (CBraMod was never a MI-classification play). The subject-identity server role is credible but not yet demonstrated (cross-session generalization unproven). Do not promote yet; do not drop (advantage too large). Run one focused cross-session experiment before building infrastructure.

evidence.dataset: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB S001-S050, runs 5&6 only, 4-class MI, 1493 trials, 50-fold LOSO
evidence.key_limitation: runs 5&6 are a single session per subject; subject-Recall measured same-session (within-session identity), NOT cross-session generalization.

roles_ranked.reason: representation advantage significant; product retrieval task unproven
richer geometry; no downstream lift shown

mi_guardrail_assessment.rationale: MI accuracy is the wrong promotion gate for a subject-identity/retrieval specialist; correct only as a MI-classification gate (which CBraMod also fails)

recommended_next_experiment.name: Mission 11 — cross-session (session-disjoint) subject retrieval
recommended_next_experiment.split: for each (subject, held-out-run): queries = held-out run trials; pool = all trials from all other runs x all subjects (held-out run excluded entirely)
recommended_next_experiment.leakage_prevention: session-disjoint + subject-disjoint on the held-out run
recommended_next_experiment.task: subject-Recall@1/5/10 with CBraMod-native-200 vs V2-32 vs PCA-32
recommended_next_experiment.statistical_test: paired t-test CBraMod vs V2; Bonferroni over 3 Recall metrics (alpha=0.0167)
recommended_next_experiment.latency_requirement: offline/batch SLO (55ms/trial CPU acceptable for Tier-2 server path)
recommended_next_experiment.success_gate: promote Tier-2 subject-identity/similarity specialist -> authorize foundation_embeddings/vector(200)/api route design

architecture_decision: two-tier architecture is the target IF Mission 11 succeeds; Tier 2 (CBraMod 200-D server/foundation) is NOT approved until then. Tier 1 (V2 32-D browser) ships.
next_mission: Mission 11 — cross-session subject-retrieval validation of the CBraMod server role (first mission in which Tier-2 infrastructure design is in scope, and only if success gate is met)
